name: negroni-bar-lab
description: Root helper scripts. Each part (web, worker, firebase, tools/seed) has its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix firebase install && npm --prefix tools/seed install && npm --prefix tools/icon install
scripts.test:worker: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-negroni "npm --prefix worker test"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-negroni "npm --prefix firebase test"
scripts.test:backend: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-negroni "npm --prefix worker test && npm --prefix firebase test && npm --prefix tools/seed test"
